en_title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Is Reportedly Already Planning a Re-Release With New Footage
cn_title: 据报道《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》拟加新镜头重映
subtitle: 删减片段回归
opus_summary: 据Deadline报道，索尼正筹备《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》的新版剪辑，计划加入此前删去的镜头后在影院重映，目前尚无档期。影片现居北美票房榜首、全球票房榜第三。

paragraphs.en: Spider-Man: Brand New Day is reportedly already planning a re-release, which will feature new footage.
paragraphs.cn: 据报道，《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》已在筹划重映，届时将加入新镜头。

paragraphs.en: Deadline has reported that Sony is preparing a new cut of Spider-Man: Brand New Day, which will be released into theaters in the future. There's currently no word on when this re-release will drop, but the window for it to happen this year is rapidly shrinking as the holiday season approaches. The new cut will feature scenes that were originally removed from the film, including one with Rosario Dawson's Daredevil character, Claire Temple .
paragraphs.cn: 据Deadline报道，索尼正准备《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》的新版剪辑，计划日后在影院上映。目前尚无重映日期的消息，但随着假日季临近，要在今年内重映，剩下的时间越来越少。新版将加入原本从影片中删去的场景，其中包括Rosario Dawson饰演的《夜魔侠》角色克莱尔·坦普尔的戏份。

paragraphs.en: This isn't the first time Sony has done this for the webhead. In 2022, the company re-released Spider-Man: No Way Home with additional footage, including extended scenes featuring all three Spider-Men. Admittedly, it wasn't anything to write home about, and it was arguably a worse movie due to how these extra scenes disrupted its overall pacing. It added about 10 extra minutes to the original film, so it's possible something similar will happen here with Brand New Day.
paragraphs.cn: 索尼此前也曾让蜘蛛侠电影以这种方式重映。2022年，索尼为《蜘蛛侠：英雄无归》加入额外镜头后重新上映，其中包括三位蜘蛛侠同框场景的加长版。说实话，新增内容没什么特别值得称道的；甚至可以说，这些场景打乱了影片的整体节奏，反而让电影变得更差了。当时的版本比原版多了约10分钟，因此《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》也可能采用类似做法。

paragraphs.en: Similarly, Avengers: Endgame is cleaning up at the box office seven years after its release thanks to a new re-release, which adds newly-shot footage that connects it to Avengers: Doomsday. All of these re-releases seem to be done with at least a partial goal of boosting the film's box office numbers; Brand New Day is currently the number one film at the domestic box office , and third globally. Avengers: Endgame's re-release is allowing it to quickly close the gap between it and the number one film, Avatar.
paragraphs.cn: 同样，《复仇者联盟：终局之战》上映七年后，凭借新一轮重映再次取得亮眼票房。这次重映加入了新拍摄的镜头，将影片与《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》联系起来。这些重映似乎至少有一部分目的是拉高票房：《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》目前位居北美票房榜首、全球票房榜第三；《复仇者联盟：终局之战》则借重映迅速缩小了与票房冠军《阿凡达》的差距。

paragraphs.en: Is it a bit greedy? Probably. But people keep showing up and it's a good way of getting people to go support a movie theater, I suppose!
paragraphs.cn: 这是不是有点贪心？大概是吧。不过观众还是会去看，我想，这也是让大家走进影院、支持电影院的一个好办法！
